intuition.title: Source-wide rationale: dopant incorporation
intuition.text: The source uses a single Zn/Se cluster precursor with a chromium feed to vary the incorporated Cr content. The measured concentration differs from the feed, so each pair is stored explicitly rather than equating loading with product composition.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF pp. 2–3, synthesis and XRF discussion

intuition.title: Proposed inclusion versus measured host
intuition.text: PXRD and SAED identify the ZnSe host, while spectroscopy and magnetic analysis motivate a proposed Cr(III) spinel-like inclusion. The source model and its etching-based location argument remain qualified; neither supplies atomically measured inclusion coordinates.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF pp. 3–7, Figures 1–6 and site-occupation discussion

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
